risk_if_not_implemented: Without Automated Unauthorized Component Detection, malicious, anomalous or unauthorized activity may go undetected or be detected too late to prevent or limit harm. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Unauthorized Modification / Loss of System Integrity (R-AM-2), Undetected / Delayed Detection of Adverse Activity (R-SA-1), and most likely increases susceptibility to Malicious Cyber Activity (MT-2), Technical / Mechanical Failure (MT-10), Data Quality Degradation / Data Poisoning (MT-12).

compensating_control_1.name: Automated Network Asset Discovery
compensating_control_1.description:
Mechanisms exist to automate network asset discovery through Software Defined Networking (SDN), or similar technologies, that analyzes network traffic to:
(1) Identify;
(2) Document; and 
(3) Track devices.
compensating_control_1.justification: Automated Network Asset Discovery (AST-09.2) provides network-level access restriction that compensates for the absence of Automated Unauthorized Component Detection (AST-11) by limiting attacker reach and lateral movement opportunities across the environment. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Continuous Monitoring
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the implementation of enterprise-wide monitoring controls.
compensating_control_2.justification: Continuous Monitoring (MON-02) provides detective monitoring capability that compensates for the absence of Automated Unauthorized Component Detection (AST-11) by identifying unauthorized, anomalous, or non-compliant activity that the primary control would have prevented. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
